comment: Two kinds of canary. upstream: real, long-standing entries that MUST be present in every fetch or the source counts as failed (SPEC.md §4). osv_canaries: the package and version the check skill queries per ecosystem; its response must print the listed id. list: fixed fake entries the list file always carries, one per type, so a bot can prove its matcher works. Fake values use reserved names (.invalid, RFC 5737 TEST-NET, CVE-0000).
